content: In our two approaches we use transformer based architectures: BERT and Transformer-XL as mentioned before. Calculating the auto-regressive $P(\mathbf {X})$ for the transformer-XL is quite straight-forward as the model is unidirectional but it doesn't factorize the same way for a bi-directional model like BERT.
